visual_action: Joe Biden stands at a podium with two microphones, in front of an American flag, and speaks directly to the camera. He makes small hand gestures for emphasis.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: He is the only person shown and is speaking throughout the entire clip.

cast.name: Billionaires
cast.evidence: Biden's speech is centered on introducing a 'billionaire minimum income tax' and he explicitly references what a 'billionaire pays' in taxes.

on_screen_text.text: Biden introduces billionaire minimum income tax

spoken_summary: Joe Biden argues that it is unfair for firefighters and teachers to pay more than double the tax rate of a billionaire. He calls this wrong and introduces a "billionaire minimum tax" as part of his budget. He specifies it would be a 20% minimum tax applying only to the "top one-hundredth of 1% of Americans." Biden concludes by stating the tax is fair, would raise $360 billion, and this money could be used to lower costs for families and cut the deficit.
audio_music: The audio consists entirely of Joe Biden's spoken remarks. There is no music or other sound.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, static, talking-head shot with no cuts or edits.
central_claim: Joe Biden's proposed billionaire minimum tax is a fair policy that will correct the injustice of billionaires paying a lower tax rate than working-class Americans.
intended_effect: To persuade viewers that the tax system is unfair and to garner support for Biden's proposed billionaire minimum tax.
